source: GTA VI: An Extended Look (Rockstar / Netflix, Aug 27, 2026)
note: Story chapters shown in the Extended Look. These are confirmed mission shapes, not a full campaign list.

missions.name: Venture Apartments
missions.summary: Opening story beat: a San4San drug-lab contact job at Venture Apartments that collapses into a task-force raid. Escape through Aunt Tee's apartment.

missions.name: Highway Chase
missions.summary: Raul Bautista recruits the pair into a bank-robbery crew. High-speed Vice City pursuit, then the freeway interchange. Cal and Brian appear as the job bleeds into the Keys.

missions.name: Corporate Gala
missions.summary: Celebrity security detail that turns into a Die Hard-style hostage sequence. Lucia's one-handed shotgun and heel stab. Private-jet outro, then the developer confirms.
